title: guest POST /v1/sessions/{id}/files/export response
description: Manifest of POST /v1/sessions/{id}/files/export (03-api.md section 7.1). The response body is application/x-tar; its first member is '.agent-export-manifest.json' with this JSON (canonical) and the header X-Manifest-Sha256 carries its sha256_hex (decisions CTR-02).

omitted.description: Only when the request named known (FIX-02): the paths of files whose content the archive leaves out, sorted; each is also in files.
